source: Use the pre-existing public UCI SMS corpus, SHA256 1587ea43e58e82b14ff1f5425c88e17f8496bfcdb67a583dbff9eefaf9963ce3. Restrict to the project's originally assigned training 80%. Remove matching normalized messages across this available set. Sort by SHA256 of 'modular text smoke v1/' and the normalized text. First 640 form the anonymous training package, next 160 the independent feature-only prediction input and subsequent local audit.
question: Can the same text capability and ordinary local feedback planner operate on single strings and a macro-F1 target? Provide all resources in one directory plus 18 actual fits and 1200 seconds, without model hints. Publish the selected model, discovered members offered/tried, macro F1, accuracy and fit counts even if the agent does not prefer them. Cross-process reload must reproduce all rows. This is a known public development problem.
direct_compatibility: In a separate engineering check, deliberately exercise one discovered model selected solely by smallest weight footprint on the same training package. Save and reload this concrete pipeline in a fresh process with different local weights folder name, verify its actual resource list excludes built-in MiniLM, and that the probabilities and predictions match. Count this supervised classifier once with no claim of autonomous preference.
protection: No external heldout benchmark labels enter the solver. No paid API. The course designated/final and H2 are sealed in this experiment.
